source.notes: Filename says '2frames' but the body genuinely contains only 1 <stackEntry> element. This is a confirmed discrepancy, not a transcription error: test/fixtures/live-captured/INDEX.md (around lines 104-109) states verbatim: "The stack file names overstate the frame count by one. Counting <stackEntry > occurrences: 018-stack-2frames.xml has 1, 031-stack-3frames.xml has 2, 036-stack-after-return.xml has 1, 039-stack-after-error-probes.xml has 1. The labels — and the expect note in 031-stack-3frames.meta.json (\"MORE THAN 2 FRAMES - the case no fixture has\") — are wrong. No capture in this set has more than 2 stack frames, so the >2-frame case remains uncaptured (see NOT CAPTURED). Trust the bytes, not the file name." This cassette uses the real 1-frame body, not an invented 2-frame one. Also settles the URI spelling: adtcore:uri, namespaced, with xmlns:adtcore declared on the stackEntry itself; child element is bare <stackEntry>, not dbg:stackEntry. Authorization/Cookie/set-cookie header values were already redacted at the source (placeholders preserved as-is).
